coaches.ledeStrong: Publish your sessions, get your own page and let people in Medellín find you.
coaches.howLede: From creating your profile to new people in your class.
coaches.step1Body: Set up your instructor profile in under 2 minutes.
coaches.step2Body: Add the sport, time, place and price. Once, or as a weekly series.
coaches.step3Body: Athletes search for your sessions and book them right in Tribe.
coaches.step4Body: By Nequi, bank transfer or cash. Tribe charges no commission; athletes pay the instructor directly.
coaches.offerLede: You set your price, your schedule and your place.
coaches.offerABody: One on one or in groups. Your price, your schedule, your place. Free too, to get known.
coaches.offerBBody: Publish once and your weekly class shows up on its own. Edit one date or the whole series.
coaches.offerCBody: Several sessions for one price. The athlete messages you on Tribe to buy it and the two of you arrange it.
coaches.offerDBody: Who you are, your style and your next sessions in one link to share on WhatsApp and Instagram.
coaches.offerEBody: We film episodes with community coaches in real sessions.
coaches.offerFBody: Manage and keep your clients, connected to Tribe.
coaches.q1: Do I need a certification to be an instructor?
coaches.a1: No formal certification is required to publish sessions on Tribe. Credentials help athletes trust you and can improve your visibility.
coaches.a2: Yes. Free sessions are a good way to build your reputation and bring in new athletes. Any session can be free.
coaches.q3: When do I get my money?
coaches.a3: When your student pays you, which the two of you arrange. Tribe does not hold or transfer money, so there is no payout to wait for.

gyms.f4b: We have already filmed at BullBox and Zona de Combate. We plan with you which sessions are worth filming.
gyms.f5b: One link with your page and your classes, ready for your bio and your WhatsApp groups.

athletes.ledeStrong: Training alone is hard. With people, you come back.
athletes.ledeRest: On Tribe you see every session for your sport in Medellín, who runs it and who goes. You ask for your spot, show up and train with a group that expects you next week.
athletes.howLede: Four steps, from knowing nobody to having a regular group.
athletes.step1Body: Filter by sport, neighborhood, price and time. See who runs the class and how many spots are left.
athletes.step2Body: Send your request. The coach confirms and tells you how to pay them.
athletes.step3Body: Show up, sweat and meet the people who train there.
athletes.step4Body: The session chat keeps you with your group. Next week you no longer show up alone.
athletes.f1b: Free community sessions or sessions with a coach. Tribe charges no commission; athletes pay the instructor directly.
athletes.f2b: Many classes repeat every week. You find them at the same time, with the same group.
athletes.f3b: No cold messages. You talk with the people you trained with.
athletes.f4b: Some partner gyms give you a free trial class. You claim the pass on Tribe and show it at the door.
athletes.f5b: Coaches with a name and a face, their style, their next sessions and what their people say.

faq.aa1: Tribe connects athletes and coaches in Medellín. You find training sessions, book with local coaches and never train alone again.
faq.aa2: Yes. Creating your profile, publishing sessions and finding sessions are free.
faq.aq3: How do I pay for a session?
faq.aa3: By Nequi, bank transfer or cash, as you agree with the instructor. Tribe charges no commission; athletes pay the instructor directly.
faq.aa4: {n} sports, from weightlifting and yoga to running, cycling, martial arts and calisthenics.
faq.aq5: How do I find sessions near me?
faq.aa5: Open Tribe and browse this week's sessions. You can filter by sport.
faq.aq6: Can I connect with other athletes?
faq.aa6: Yes. When you join a session, you chat with the other participants. Connections come from training together, not from following profiles.
faq.aq7: What if a session is full?
faq.aa7: You join the session waitlist. You can also message the coach.
faq.aq8: What if I need a refund?
faq.aa8: Talk to the instructor. Since you paid them directly, the refund is between the two of you. You can message them through Tribe.
faq.cq1: How do I become an instructor?
faq.ca1: Sign up, choose "Instructor" and complete your profile. You can publish sessions right away. There is no approval process.
faq.ca2: No formal certification is required to publish sessions on Tribe. Credentials help athletes trust you and can improve your visibility.
faq.cq3: Do I need my own gym?
faq.ca3: No. Many coaches run sessions in parks, outdoors or in shared spaces. You choose the place for each session.
faq.cq4: Can I publish a weekly class?
faq.ca4: Yes. Create the session once, set the pattern and Tribe creates each date. You can edit one date or the whole series.
faq.cq5: When do I get my money?
faq.ca5: When your student pays you, which the two of you arrange. Tribe does not hold or transfer money, so there is no payout to wait for.
faq.cq6: What is Tribe.OS and when is it coming?
faq.ca6: It is the system to manage and keep your clients, connected to Tribe. It is in development.
faq.ua1: We only share data with the providers that run Tribe, such as hosting and database services, and we never sell it. Your location is only shown at the session level, never your home address.
faq.ua2: Yes. You can delete your account at any time from your profile settings. When you do, we immediately remove your name, email, photo and location.
faq.aa9: Several sessions with a coach for one price. You message the coach on Tribe to buy it.
faq.aa10: For now, yes. We want Tribe to work really well in Medellín before reaching other cities in Colombia and Latin America.

os.lead: Tribe.OS is the system for coaches and gyms that already have clients: who comes, who stopped coming, what each one is training and how to reach them. It lives inside Tribe, so the people who arrive through Tribe are already on your list.
os.bridgeLede: Tribe brings them in. Tribe.OS keeps them.
os.leftBody: Athletes who did not know you find your session, ask for a spot and show up.
os.rightBody: Here is how it will work: that athlete lands on your client list on their own, marked "Came from Tribe", so you look after them from day one.
os.bringsLede: We are building it with real coaches and gyms in Medellín. It may change before launch.
os.l1b: Every client with their history, notes and where they came from.
os.l2b: Who comes, who stopped coming and who is about to leave.
os.l3b: Training plans you build and assign to your clients.
os.l4b: To one client or a whole group, from the same place.
os.l5b: Your sessions, spots and clients in one calendar.
os.l6b: Members and coaches for the whole gym in one account.
os.waitNote: We let people into Tribe.OS in groups. Leave your details and we will write when your spot opens.
